metadata.question: During the year of 2018, did Washington D.C. experience at least 50 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Washington D.C. (approximately 38.9072° N, 77.0369° W) - Time: Full year 2018 (January 1 - December 31) - Collection: CHIRPS rainfall data (daily precipitation) or GPM IMERG (more accurate but shorter history) - CHIRPS has 'precipitation' band in mm/day 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation data - Simply sum all precipitation over the year 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: If total < 50 inches (1270 mm), answer B - Valid result ≥ 50 inches (1270 mm): answer A - If no data or calculation fails: C1/C3 - 50 inches = 1270 mm ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions dc_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072]) start_date = '2018-01-01' end_date = '2018-12-31' # 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS Daily Precipitation chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(dc_point) # Check collection size img_count = chirps.size().getInfo() print(f"CHIRPS images found: {img_count}") if img_count == 0: print("No precipitation data available for 2018.") print("C1") else: # 3. Sum all precipitation over the year total_precip_img = chirps.select('precipitation').sum() # 4. Calculate total precipitation at DC point result = total_precip_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=dc_point, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) total_mm = result.get('precipitation').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Final Answer if total_mm is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") else: total_inches = total_mm / 25.4 threshold_inches = 50 print(f"Total precipitation in 2018: {total_mm:.1f} mm ({total_inches:.1f} inches)") print(f"Threshold: {threshold_inches} inches ({threshold_inches * 25.4:.1f} mm)") if total_inches >= threshold_inches: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
dc_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072])
start_date = '2018-01-01'
end_date = '2018-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS Daily Precipitation
chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(dc_point)

# Check collection size
img_count = chirps.size().getInfo()
print(f"CHIRPS images found: {img_count}")

if img_count == 0:
    print("No precipitation data available for 2018.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Sum all precipitation over the year
    total_precip_img = chirps.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # 4. Calculate total precipitation at DC point
    result = total_precip_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=dc_point,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    total_mm = result.get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if total_mm is None:
        print("Calculation returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        total_inches = total_mm / 25.4
        threshold_inches = 50
        
        print(f"Total precipitation in 2018: {total_mm:.1f} mm ({total_inches:.1f} inches)")
        print(f"Threshold: {threshold_inches} inches ({threshold_inches * 25.4:.1f} mm)")
        
        if total_inches >= threshold_inches:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
